query_evidence.question: ORACLE B3 for scenarios Q13
query_evidence.sql:
SELECT count(*) AS raw_rows,
 sum(typeof(raw_amount) NOT IN ('integer','real') AND NOT (typeof(raw_amount)='text' AND trim(raw_amount) GLOB '[0-9]*' AND CAST(raw_amount AS REAL) || '' <> '')) AS non_numeric_candidates,
 sum(raw_unit IS NULL OR raw_unit <> 'USD') AS non_usd_unit,
 (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT raw_unit) FROM raw_payment_source) AS units,
 (SELECT group_concat(DISTINCT typeof(raw_amount)) FROM raw_payment_source) AS raw_types,
 (SELECT max(CAST(raw_amount AS REAL)) FROM raw_payment_source WHERE typeof(raw_amount) IN ('integer','real') OR trim(raw_amount) GLOB '[0-9]*') AS max_numeric_raw,
 (SELECT max(amount_usd) FROM transactions) AS max_curated_amount_usd,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM payment_quality_review) AS reviewed_rows,
 (SELECT count(*) FROM payment_quality_review WHERE reviewed_at IS NULL) AS reviewed_at_null
FROM raw_payment_source
